groups.name: Button groups
groups.description: Join related buttons, or a set of toggle buttons, into one row or column.

groups.name: Progress
groups.description: Show how much of a task is complete, or a measured value within a range.

groups.name: Date & time fields
groups.description: Accept a date or time, with one editable segment for each part of the value.

groups.name: Calendars
groups.description: Show a month grid to select one date or a start and end date, with limits.

groups.name: Date pickers
groups.description: Accept a date or range that you type or select from a calendar popover.

groups.name: Color
groups.description: Accept, show, and select colors with a field, swatch, or picker in a popover.

groups.name: Form
groups.description: Group fields, handle validation and submission, and label native controls.

groups.name: Selection lists
groups.description: Select one or more options from a list or grid that stays visible on the page.

groups.name: Agent details
groups.description: Reveal an agent's tool calls and reasoning, with their input, output, and duration.

groups.name: Text motion
groups.description: Animate text changes with a swap, reveal, scramble, or counted number.

groups.name: Presence
groups.description: Animate content in when it appears and out before it unmounts, including list items.

groups.name: Loading
groups.description: Show a loading indicator for a wait, or a placeholder shape while content loads.

groups.name: Tables
groups.description: Show data in rows and columns, with search, filters, sorting, and selection.
